newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers dip, demand dies.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers dip, demand dies.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices softened slightly on Wednesday and demand tailed off after a large volume of enquiries a day ago, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was quoted in the range $86/$87 fob as the barge market traded mostly at the lower end of this week's $85/$86 a tonne range.
After a day of hectic business on Tuesday, most shipowners were either fully supplied with product or uninterested.
Most suppliers questioned said total ARA demand was no higher than 10,000 tonnes.
"We have seen just 3,000 tonnes all day," one supplier said.
One refinery in Antwerp appeared to be having difficulty delivering, and some liftings were subject to 24 hour delays.
Hamburg quotes were stable and demand again low.
Mediterranean fuel oil and gas oil prices barely changed. Supplies in Greece remained tight with continuing refinery maintenance, brokers said.
